svg.title: Researcher, Analyst or a Custom Agent
svg.desc: Choosing a reasoning agent: documents and web sources go to Researcher for a cited report, a dataset goes to Analyst for code-driven analysis and charts, and a company-specific process goes to a custom Copilot Studio agent.
svg.text: Researcher, Analyst or a Custom Agent
Choose by the input: documents, a dataset, or a company-specific process.
